title: Zig: Even or Odd
description: Check if a number is even or odd using @mod.

steps.title: Even or Odd Check
steps.description: Declare const num: i32 = 7. Use @mod to check if num % 2 == 0 and print 'Even' or 'Odd'.
hints: Zig uses `@mod` instead of % for modulo.
